meta.seoTitle: Simba Logistics & Supply Co. | Freight, Clearance & Procurement — Tanzania
meta.seoDescription: Tanzania's trusted logistics and supply partner. Freight forwarding, customs clearance, government procurement, and door-to-door delivery across East Africa.

hero.headline: Tanzania's Most Trusted
hero.subheadline: We move goods, clear customs, and supply government institutions — on time, every time, anywhere in Tanzania and East Africa.

about.heading:
Reliability You Can
Count On
body: Simba Logistics & Supply Co. Ltd is a Dar es Salaam-based logistics, freight, and supply company with a decade of experience moving goods across Tanzania and the East African region.
From sea freight at Dar Port to last-mile delivery in rural districts, we offer complete supply chain solutions for private businesses, NGOs, and government institutions.

director.name: Mr. Juma Simba
director.title: Managing Director
director.quote: We don't just deliver goods. We deliver confidence to every client who trusts us with their supply chain.

items.title: Sea Freight
items.body: Full container (FCL) and shared container (LCL) shipments from any global port to Dar es Salaam, Tanga, and Mtwara.

items.title: Road Freight & Haulage
items.body: Heavy-duty trucking for bulk goods, construction materials, and general cargo across Tanzania and East Africa.

items.title: Customs Clearance
items.body: Fast, compliant TRA customs clearance at all major Tanzanian ports and border crossing points.

items.title: Government Supply
items.body: Tender-winning supply of office furniture, electronics, stationery, PPE, and general consumables to ministries and institutions.

items.title: Warehousing & Storage
items.body: Secure dry and temperature-controlled warehousing in Dar es Salaam with inventory management systems.

items.title: Distribution & Last Mile
items.body: Nationwide distribution reaching all 26 regions with dedicated vehicles and local agents.

items.title: TRA & TBS Licensed
items.body: Fully licensed clearing and forwarding agent with all required government registrations.

items.title: Fast Clearance
items.body: Most customs clearances processed within 24–48 hours of vessel arrival.

items.title: Global Network
items.body: Partnerships with freight agents in over 40 countries for seamless worldwide shipping.

items.title: Dedicated Account Team
items.body: Each client gets a dedicated account officer who manages all shipments end-to-end.

items.title: Cargo Insurance
items.body: All consignments covered with comprehensive marine and inland transit insurance.

items.title: 24/7 Support
items.body: Our operations team is reachable around the clock for urgent clearance and delivery.
